game_info.title: Star Trek Rules & Lore Database
game_info.description: Synthesized rules from major Star Trek tabletop games: Star Trek Adventures (2d20), Star Fleet Battles, and Star Trek: Alien Worlds
source_games: Star Fleet Battles (Amarillo Design Bureau, 1979, 5th Ed 2019)

ground_combat.description: Narrative ground combat using 2d20 pool system with Action Dice for damage resolution

core_mechanic.description: Roll 2d20 + Attribute + Skill vs Target Number (TN). Results generate Successes, Advantages, Threats, and Complications.

action_dice.description: When an action could cause harm or stress, roll Action Dice (d6s) to determine the degree of effect.

combat_phases.description: Ground combat resolves in turns, with each character taking actions based on their initiative.
combat_phases.initiative: Dexterity + Awareness vs TN 6; higher total acts first
actions_per_turn: Move — up to Agility + Athletics meters
Attack — melee or ranged weapon attack
Defend — active defense roll (Agility + Athletics vs attacker's Brawn + Weapon Skill)
Use Skill — any non-combat skill action
Draw/Reload — prepare weapon for next attack

steps: Attacker rolls Brawn + Weapon Skill vs TN 6 (unarmed) or weapon TN
Each Success deals 1 damage (Action Dice determine severity)
Defender may attempt Active Defense: Agility + Athletics vs attacker's total
If defense equals or exceeds attack, the attack is blocked
Attacker rolls Dexterity + Weapon Skill vs TN based on range
Range modifiers: Point-blank (no modifier), Short (+0), Medium (+2), Long (+4)
Each Success deals damage equal to weapon's Action Dice rating
Cover provides bonus to defense: Light cover (+2), Heavy cover (+4)

damage.description: Characters have two damage tracks: Stress (temporary) and Damage (permanent).
damage.stress: Absorbs damage first; when Stress is full, excess becomes Damage
damage.damage: Permanent wounds; when Damage equals Toughness, the character is incapacitated
damage.toughness: Brawn + Resilience; determines total Stress and Damage capacity

phaser.description: Standard Starfleet energy weapon with adjustable settings

settings.stun: Non-lethal; targets accumulate Stress instead of Damage
settings.disintegrate: Maximum setting; deals extra Action Dice but risks collateral damage

phasgun.description: Heavy phaser rifle with increased range and power

hand_laser.description: Klingon sidearm; less precise but devastating at close range

bat'leth.description: Klingon curved sword; requires two hands

space_combat.description: Tactical ship-to-ship combat using hex-based movement and impulse-based turns

game_round.description: Each game round represents 1 minute of in-game time, divided into 6 Impulse Segments and 1 Missile Segment.
game_round.missile_segment: Resolved after impulse 6; all missiles launched this round resolve here

movement_phase.description: Ships move using their warp or impulse drive ratings on a hex grid.
steps: Declare movement: Warp, Impulse, or Stationary
Move ship along a course using drive rating
Resolve collision if ships occupy the same hex

weapon_fire_phase.description: Ships fire weapons based on arc (Forward, Aft, Broadside) and range.
steps: Roll to hit: Ship's firing number vs target's evasion
Resolve damage: Hit points applied to target's hull or shields
Check for critical hits on shielded targets

missile_segment.description: All missiles launched this round reach their targets.

ship_statistics.hull_points: Structural integrity; when reduced to 0, the ship is destroyed
ship_statistics.shield_points: Energy barrier; absorbs damage before hull. Regenerates when not under fire.
ship_statistics.warp_drive: FTL travel; measured in warp factors (Warp 1-9+)
ship_statistics.impulse_drive: Sublight maneuvering; measured in impulse factors per segment
ship_statistics.phaser_bank: Primary energy weapon; measured in phaser factors per arc
ship_statistics.deflector_shields: Shield strength; measured in shield factors

phasers.description: Directed energy weapons; primary armament of most ships

types.forward: Fired from the front arc; highest firepower
types.aft: Fired from the rear arc; lower firepower
types.broadside: Fired from the sides; medium firepower

phasers.range: Measured in hexes; effective range varies by ship class

photon_torpedoes.description: Antimatter warhead projectiles; devastating but limited in number
photon_torpedoes.damage: Rolls on torpedo damage table; can cause catastrophic damage

types.quantum: Enhanced yield; introduced in TNG era

deflector_shields.description: Energy barriers that absorb incoming damage
deflector_shields.regeneration: Shields regenerate when not taking damage; rate varies by ship
deflector_shields.modulation: Shield frequency can be shifted to reduce incoming damage
deflector_shields.directional: Shields can be focused forward, aft, or broadside

damage_system.description: Damage is tracked on a ship's damage track, with specific systems that can be disabled.

damage_types.hull_damage: Permanent structural damage; reduces ship capabilities
damage_types.shield_damage: Temporary; shields regenerate when not under fire
damage_types.system_disruption: Temporary loss of a system (warp, impulse, weapons)
damage_types.system_destruction: Permanent loss of a system; requires repair
damage_types.crew_casualties: Loss of crew members; reduces ship effectiveness

critical_hits.description: When shields are down, hits can cause critical system failures
examples: Warp drive failure — ship cannot use warp
Impulse failure — ship cannot maneuver at sublight
Bridge casualty — command and control degraded

rpg_mechanics.description: 2d20 narrative dice system for roleplaying adventures across all Star Trek eras

core_mechanic.description: Roll 2d20 + Attribute + Skill vs Target Number. Results generate Successes, Advantages, Threats, and Complications.

outcome_table.description: The two d20 results are looked up on the 2d20 Outcome Table.
outcome_table.failure: 1 Threat (highest die is 1, or both dice equal and low)
outcome_table.success: 1 Success + 1 Advantage (highest die is 20, or both dice equal and high)

modifiers.description: Circumstances modify the roll by adding or subtracting from the total.

skills.description: Skills represent trained abilities, paired with attributes.

stress_and_trauma.description: Characters accumulate Stress from dangerous situations. When Stress is full, further stress causes Trauma.
stress_and_trauma.stress_track: Based on the character's Toughness (Brawn + Resilience)
stress_and_trauma.trauma: Permanent psychological scars; each Trauma imposes a penalty or limitation
stress_and_trauma.recovery: Stress recovers during downtime; Trauma requires therapy or significant events to heal

ship_combat.description: Starship combat uses the same 2d20 system, with ship stats replacing character attributes.

bridge_officers.description: Each bridge station is managed by an officer whose skills modify the ship's capabilities.
bridge_officers.science: Science (Intelligence) — sensor analysis and shield modulation
bridge_officers.engineering: Engineering (Intelligence) — warp drive and power distribution

ship_actions: Repair — fix damage from previous rounds
